Actual original PNG viewed: 1440×1160; viewport 1440×900; theme light; fullPage true. Gray read-through arrow points upward toward Redis while pink JWT arrow points down into API; their shared corridor does not reverse the facts. Region caption interrupts part of a straight JWT segment but continuation is clear. Labels and lower legend remain readable and the right control dock stays below them.

Theme/style/Still/export and route/lens/zoom controls do not mask content.
